description: Election Commission - K. Thurarathnam was Selected as the member of the Nawalapitiya U/C
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of a local government body (Nawalapitiya Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process at the local government level, specifically the nomination and declaration of an elected member to fill a vacant seat, which falls under the Elections classification.
